item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent that outcome—not race toward it.

2. We refuse to accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on that scale. We demand action to stop it.

3. We cannot build our future by destroying it. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We stand for preventing that catastrophe before it begins.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe our responsibility is clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We will not treat those lives as an acceptable cost of progress. We will not confuse the ability to build something with a mandate to unleash it. We must stop this race before its consequences become irreversible. That means demanding enforceable limits on development, holding decision-makers accountable, and building public pressure strong enough to put human survival first. We have a future worth defending, and we intend to defend it—not gamble it away.
